name: Aurora field
summary: A soft chromatic background with an editable palette.
body: A layered radial-gradient field for title cards and calm product backdrops. Change the three gradient stops to fit the brand; place text over the quieter center.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 640"><defs><radialGradient id="a" cx=".18" cy=".15" r=".9"><stop stop-color="#bceaa5"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#bceaa5" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient><radialGradient id="b" cx=".88" cy=".7" r=".8"><stop stop-color="#cb9278"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#cb9278" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient><radialGradient id="c" cx=".32" cy=".9" r=".62"><stop stop-color="#306b6a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#306b6a" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient></defs><rect width="640" height="640" fill="#102a31"/><g id="field"><rect width="640" height="640" fill="url(#a)"/><rect width="640" height="640" fill="url(#b)"/><rect width="640" height="640" fill="url(#c)"/></g></svg>

name: The type opener
summary: Oversized editorial type with one sharp accent.
body: An editorial opener with a small issue line, large two-line title and an accent rule. Edit the title, index and subtitle; animate the title group vertically for a restrained reveal.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 640"><defs></defs><rect width="640" height="640" fill="#e9e9dc"/><text x="48" y="65" fill="#4a5145" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="17" >STUDIO NOTES / 01</text><g id="title"><text x="42" y="276" fill="#243629" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="132" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="-8">Make</text><text x="42" y="404" fill="#243629" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="132" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="-8">it felt.</text></g><path d="M48 454H592" stroke="#e77a35" stroke-width="14"/><text x="48" y="570" fill="#4a5145" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="22" >A different kind of first impression.</text></svg>

name: Caption stack
summary: Readable phrase-by-phrase captions for a vertical edit.
body: A high-contrast three-line caption treatment. Replace phrases with actual transcription, align timing to spoken words and highlight only one meaningful phrase at a time.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 640"><defs></defs><rect width="640" height="640" fill="#213127"/><g id="captions"><rect x="66" y="198" width="494" height="72" rx="10" fill="#f5f0e8"/><rect x="86" y="282" width="474" height="72" rx="10" fill="#dcff6b"/><rect x="146" y="366" width="414" height="72" rx="10" fill="#f5f0e8"/><text x="90" y="247" fill="#141714" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="43" font-weight="700">ONE GOOD IDEA</text><text x="110" y="331" fill="#141714" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="40" font-weight="700">IS ALL IT TAKES</text><text x="170" y="415" fill="#141714" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="40" font-weight="700">TO GET GOING.</text></g><text x="66" y="565" fill="#aeb3a5" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="20" >Phrase by phrase. Always readable.</text></svg>

name: A quiet introduction
summary: An understated name and role plate for interviews.
body: A compact lower-third label with a vertical accent. Replace name and role, anchor it inside title-safe margins and keep it visible long enough to read before fading out.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 640"><defs></defs><rect width="640" height="640" fill="#e1e5d9"/><path d="M0 410L640 190V640H0Z" fill="#cad0bc"/><g id="nameplate"><rect x="48" y="392" width="544" height="155" fill="#f8f6ee"/><rect x="48" y="392" width="8" height="155" fill="#b86446"/><text x="81" y="458" fill="#262b29" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="41" font-weight="600">Alex Morgan</text><text x="82" y="500" fill="#59605b" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="22" >Designer & storyteller</text></g><text x="48" y="80" fill="#4d5851" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" >THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE WORK</text></svg>

name: Words worth keeping
summary: A large quote card with an unobtrusive attribution.
body: A quote layout for a carousel or interview cutaway. Use the exact approved quote, keep line lengths short, and include a factual attribution. Never invent a quote or author.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 640"><defs></defs><rect width="640" height="640" fill="#302d29"/><text x="48" y="170" fill="#d77957" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="180" >“</text><g id="quote"><text x="62" y="267" fill="#eee9df" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="68" >The details</text><text x="62" y="345" fill="#eee9df" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="68" >are the</text><text x="62" y="423" fill="#eee9df" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="68" >whole thing.</text></g><path d="M64 480H576" stroke="#726255"/><text x="64" y="544" fill="#c2b5a6" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" >A PLACE FOR YOUR QUOTE</text></svg>

name: Next chapter
summary: A simple chapter card for an essay or documentary.
body: A chapter separator with a large chapter number and restrained title. Change the index and section name, then use a short hold between longer segments.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 640"><defs></defs><rect width="640" height="640" fill="#242b2c"/><text x="44" y="380" fill="#3b4145" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="320" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="-24">02</text><g id="chapter"><path d="M52 431H587" stroke="#dfedba" stroke-width="2"/><text x="52" y="500" fill="#dfedba" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="58" >A closer look</text><text x="54" y="550" fill="#a5afa9" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" >CHAPTER TWO</text></g></svg>

name: Orbit mark
summary: A geometric motion accent with a clear center of gravity.
body: An abstract orbital mark built from named SVG groups. Recolor the strokes and central disk; rotate the orbit group slowly around the viewBox center for a looping identity accent.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 640"><defs></defs><rect width="640" height="640" fill="#e4e8df"/><g id="orbits" stroke="#4a6365" fill="none" stroke-width="2"><ellipse cx="320" cy="320" rx="256" ry="100" transform="rotate(-35 320 320)"/><ellipse cx="320" cy="320" rx="256" ry="100" transform="rotate(35 320 320)"/><ellipse cx="320" cy="320" rx="100" ry="256"/></g><g id="core"><circle cx="320" cy="320" r="72" fill="#df623f"/><circle cx="520" cy="179" r="13" fill="#243a3b"/></g></svg>

name: Leave a note
summary: A closing frame with space for a useful next step.
body: A minimal end card with one next action. Replace sample text with a real next step, URL or release date; keep it short enough to read within the final three seconds.
svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 640"><defs></defs><rect width="640" height="640" fill="#e9b7a1"/><text x="48" y="67" fill="#513f38" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="17" >UNTIL NEXT TIME</text><g id="closing"><text x="48" y="280" fill="#403a35" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="112" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="-5">Keep</text><text x="48" y="394" fill="#403a35" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="112" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="-5">looking.</text><path d="M53 493H567M537 463L567 493L537 523" stroke="#403a35" stroke-width="6" fill="none"/></g><text x="48" y="580" fill="#513f38" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="18" >YOUR NEXT CHAPTER STARTS HERE</text></svg>
